items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: I saw Red Baptiste, I told him, I said, Red, I want to get to the only Jacks.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. At that time, when I lived out late, I heard about 20 Jacks and I wanted to go with a good little excellent man. So, well, I got real. I'm sure I got this old shit. Four years, and when I got to Chicago, I had a bad team. I worked for the brothers, the Knifling, and all the other. I saw Red Baptiste, I told him, I said, Red, I want to get to the only Jacks. I remember so much of my head, I take me up to the last class. I got a good job here at 22 Jacks. I've read back these…
Oh yeah, I think it's been a good job.
